series.label: Terrestrial water storage anomaly (GRACE/GRACE-FO, Bangladesh mean)

method: OLS on monthly anomaly with annual + semi-annual harmonics; 95% CI from OLS standard error (residual autocorrelation not accounted for, so the CI is likely too narrow).
note: Regional storage trend, roughly 300 km resolution; not well depth.
